subject.name_or_desc: The world — collective conditions at the 2020–2021 mark

context.question: What major collective affliction, if any, does the 2020–2021 period hold?
context.setting: No pandemic is underway in 2011–12; the last influenza event was the mild 2009 H1N1 surge. The five outer planets will gather within about 100 degrees around 2020, with a Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction, at the lowest cyclical-index reading of the 21st century; comparable past clusters coincided with 1918, 1954, 1968 and 1982.

attachments.configuration: Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction (exact early 2020); five outer planets within ~100 degrees; cyclical index at its 21st-century low

provenance.work: L'Astrologue no.177 (2012), 'Aperçu sur les Pandémies'; text and translation as quoted in The Astrology Podcast episode 'Misconceptions About Mundane Astrology in the Media' (11 May 2020)
provenance.edition: Journal issue 177, Q1 2012; English translation by Mark Cullen (Skyscript forum) as quoted in the podcast transcript
